summary: Improve budget formulation, execution monitoring and fiscal reporting with practical public financial management exercises. Explore the course outline.
lede: Public sector budget governance helps officials connect fiscal priorities with affordable allocations and accountable spending. For budget officers, analysts and public finance advisers, the course covers checking submissions and costing against fiscal ceilings, tracking commitments and cash, and reporting variances. Participants also assess fiscal risks and turn spending-review findings into allocation options and reform actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for officials who prepare, scrutinize, execute or assess public budgets and need to connect fiscal limits with accountable spending and evidence-based reform.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public budgeting, budget execution or public financial management is expected. Coding is not required; exercises use budget information and spreadsheet-based analysis.
